description:
[h1]New planet card system - Multiplayer gameplay expansion![/h1]
[h1]New effect config panel - Custom card visuals![/h1]
[h2]Gameplay Introduction[/h2]
This mod adds -44 Tarot cards- and -12 Planet cards-, bringing -52 brand-new card enchantments- and -4 unique immediate effects- to the game. You can draw Tarot cards at the shop for 75-99 gold, personally enchanting your deck with unique powers and enjoying a different roguelike deck experience every run. The mod also features 2 exclusive Tarot enchantments for each of the five original characters, as well as 10 hidden special Tarot cards.
Additionally, with the Stargazer Kit relic (automatically granted in multiplayer), you can Stargaze at Rest Sites to enchant your deck with multiplayer co-op exclusive Planet card effects and fight alongside your allies!

All Tarot cards are integrated into the shop interface and can be drawn via a new interactive button. You can view collected Tarot cards in the compendium. Crack open a pack, draw cards, enchant them, DIY your own deck, and enjoy the roguelike fun!

[h2]Effect Configuration[/h2]
This mod adds a "PengoTarot Config Panel" at the bottom right of the Card Inspect screen. Inside, you can individually configure nearly 20 shader effects for each card component — Foil and Polychrome from Balatro, outlines, pixelation, and even mysterious custom-designed effects! All effects support dynamic 3D tilt (enable it at the bottom left of the Compendium) and come alive when you play your cards. Let these effects bring more flair to your battles!
The custom card effect source code comes from the mod "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3747874832]BalatroEfffect[/url]". Huge thanks to the author [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198137072778]Ind_E[/url] for uploading the open-source code on GitHub!

[h2]Enchantment Compendium[/h2]
For those who want to browse and manage enchantment effects, check out this mod: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3750879024]Enchantment Compendium[/url]. It adds a new page to the compendium for easily browsing enchantment icons and effects from both the base game and all mods! Check it out!

[h1]Tarot Effects Overview[/h1]
 (Hover over the "Spoiler" block on the right to view the list) → [spoiler] Highly simplified to stay within Steam's character limit~
[table]
[tr][th]Tarot[/th][th]Upright Effect[/th][th]Reversed Effect[/th][/tr]
[tr][td]The Fool[/td][td]First play: return to hand.[/td][td]First play: add a +1 cost copy to hand.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]The Magician[/td][td]Gain Exhaust.[/td][td]After play, placed randomly in draw pile.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]The High Priestess[/td][td]Gain Ethereal.[/td][td]Gain Retain. End of turn: left cards gain Ethereal.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]The Empress[/td][td]3rd+ play: gain Replay 1.[/td][td]Cost -1, unplayable until first discarded.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]The Emperor[/td][td]Gain Retain.[/td][td]End of turn: 2 random hand cards gain Retain.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]The Hierophant[/td][td]After play: Upgrade a hand card.[/td][td]Downgrade any cards; each upgrades 3 in draw/discard.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]The Lovers[/td][td]On entering hand: fetch other Lovers card.[/td][td]After play: fetch other Lovers card, it costs +1.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]The Chariot[/td][td]Apply +1 Vulnerable.[/td][td]Self 1 Vulnerable; each hit applies 1 Vulnerable.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Strength[/td][td]Apply +1 Weak.[/td][td]Self 1 Weak; each hit applies 1 Weak.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]The Hermit[/td][td]Exhaust on start; return turn 2.[/td][td]Exhaust on start; return free turn 7.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Wheel of Fortune[/td][td]Lose 11 HP; copy random non-Ancient Relic.[/td][td]Destroy 2 random non-Ancient Relics; copy one x3.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Justice[/td][td]Gain Exhaust; damage x2.[/td][td]Gain Exhaust; gain Block equal to damage dealt.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]The Hanged Man[/td][td]When another is Exhausted, play this instead.[/td][td]On play: Exhaust another random hand card, self to discard.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Death[/td][td]Costs 0; end your turn.[/td][td]Costs 0; can't draw while in hand; play has no effect.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Temperance[/td][td]First play: gain 10 Gold.[/td][td]Gain 5 Gold per unblocked damage taken this turn.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]The Devil[/td][td]Cost -1; must play first while in hand.[/td][td]Cost -1 per 3 HP lost; resets on play.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]The Tower[/td][td]Remove Basic/Common/Uncommon; 45 Gold each.[/td][td]Remove Basic/Common; 15 Gold each.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]The Star[/td][td]Gain Block equal to Stars.[/td][td]Swap Energy cost and Star cost.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]The Moon[/td][td]End of turn 1: auto-play, return to draw pile.[/td][td]When discarded: return to hand.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]The Sun[/td][td]Halve a random debuff's stacks.[/td][td]Costs 0; original cost gives 6x Doom.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Judgement[/td][td]Start of combat: transform randomly.[/td][td]All Judgement cards placed at bottom of draw pile.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]The World[/td][td]On Evoke: fetch from anywhere, costs +1.[/td][td]First play: gain 1 Artifact.[/td][/tr]

[h1]Planet Effects Overview[/h1]
With the Stargazer Kit relic, Stargaze at Rest Sites to obtain Planet cards and enchant your deck with multiplayer co-op exclusive effects.
 (Hover over the "Spoiler" block on the right to view the list) → [spoiler] Highly simplified to stay within Steam's character limit~
[table]
[tr][th]Planet Card[/th][th]Type[/th][th]Effect[/th][/tr]

[tr][td]Venus[/td][td]Power[/td][td]After ally discards, pick cards from their discard pile to hand.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Earth[/td][td]Power[/td][td]Sync Energy with an ally.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Mars[/td][td]Power[/td][td]Sync Generation with an ally.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Jupiter[/td][td]Attack[/td][td]Hit enemies grant all players equal Gold; end turn in 10s.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Saturn[/td][td]Attack[/td][td]Hit enemies take no less damage this turn; end turn in 10s.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Uranus[/td][td]Attack[/td][td]After play: +1 cost, gain 2 Replay, place in ally's draw pile.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Neptune[/td][td]Attack[/td][td]Copy into all players' discard piles.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Pluto[/td][td]Skill[/td][td]First play: allies' Pluto cards cost 0 and enter hand.[/td][/tr]
